description: This file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class for rendering different sections of a home screen in an Android app, including header, banner, and content rows, with associated view holders and models.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering home screen sections including header, banner, and content rows in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: SectionItem
classes.description: Sealed class representing different types of sections in the home screen: header, banner, and content row.

classes.name: HeaderSection
classes.description: Model for header section containing categories.

classes.name: BannerSection
classes.description: Model for banner section containing banner items.

classes.name: ContentRowSection
classes.description: Model for content row section containing a ContentRow.

classes.name: BannerItem
classes.description: Model representing individual banner items (referenced but not defined in this file).

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Model representing a row of content items (referenced but not defined in this file).

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for a given position based on the section item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on section item.

methods.name: HeaderSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds header section data, sets up brand styling and top navigation behavior.

methods.name: BannerSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds banner section data, configures horizontal banner RecyclerView with size and focus behavior.

methods.name: ContentRowSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds content row data, sets up inner RecyclerView with focus handling.
